title: Anaconda Navigator — What it is
description: Anaconda Navigator (by Anaconda Inc.) is the point-and-click front end to the conda ecosystem: create and switch Python environments, install packages, and launch JupyterLab, VS Code, Spyder and more without touching the terminal. Underneath it is the same conda that data scientists use to pin numpy, PyTorch and CUDA builds per project — Navigator just makes the environment zoo visible and manageable. It is made by Anaconda, Inc. and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux.
